## 更新 · What's new

- 公网中继 SDK 升级至 `JunWeiUp/common-relay` v0.2.2（macOS 与 Flutter 同步升级并锁定版本）。
  Upgraded the Internet relay SDK to `JunWeiUp/common-relay` v0.2.2 across macOS and Flutter with pinned lockfiles.
- 优化公网设备组扫码/粘贴邀请加入流程：未入组设备验证加密邀请通过后自动采纳邀请中的中继服务器地址与访问密码，无需先手动修改中继地址；已入组设备仍保持原有跨服务器保护。
  Improved relay group onboarding: unenrolled devices automatically adopt the relay server URL and access password from a verified invitation without editing the relay URL first, while enrolled devices retain cross-server protection.
- 优化 Android 设备页卡片布局：取消操作区缩进改为单行通栏按钮（不再截断「发送文本」「发送文件」），Mac 锁屏/解锁合并为单个智能状态按钮并将锁定状态并入副标题，沿用原有图标与主题风格。
  Refined Android Devices cards: full-width single-row action bar without button text truncation, combined Mac Lock/Unlock into a single state-aware action button with inline status in the subtitle, preserving the existing icon and theme style.
- 工程与架构优化：新增 Swift/Dart 共用 Protocol v3 契约测试向量、双端多语言对称性校验与架构守卫脚本；拆分 `OverlayView`、`sync_manager` 与 `notification_sync_page` 超大单文件；新增 `clipy_macos/Package.swift` 支持开发期增量编译。
  Engineering & architecture improvements: added shared Swift/Dart Protocol v3 contract fixtures, localization symmetry checks, and architecture guardrails; split oversized `OverlayView`, `sync_manager`, and `notification_sync_page` files; added `clipy_macos/Package.swift` for incremental development builds.
